subject: Seed Pilot stipend & one-off pricing exception for LaunchForge cohort
messages:
From: Aaron Kim <aaron@launchforge.vc>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jenna Ortiz <jenna@launchforge.vc>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot stipend ask for LaunchForge cohort

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers looked great and the team was impressed with the cost tooling. LaunchForge is starting its next cohort in January and we run a short 8-week seed pilot with 10 teams (mostly early PoCs). Historically we ask vendor partners for a small onboarding stipend to offset initial usage spikes.

Quick ask: would Redwood consider providing a one-time promotional stipend (either $3k worth of hosted credits or equivalent token credits) for the cohort, plus an introductory 30% discount for the first month of paid usage after the stipend is exhausted? This helps accelerate adoption and gives us a clear story to present to founders.

We can sign a short SOW and agree on pilot metrics (active projects, avg daily tokens) — attaching the cohort SOW draft I mentioned.

Attachment: LaunchForge_SOW_draft.pdf (PDF)

Happy to jump on a quick call today if helpful.

Best,
Aaron
Aaron Kim
Programs Director | LaunchForge
aaron@launchforge.vc
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aaron Kim <aaron@launchforge.vc>
Cc: Jenna Ortiz <jenna@launchforge.vc>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 12:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot stipend ask for LaunchForge cohort

Hi Aaron — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the SOW. The cohort sounds like a great fit.

Quick answers up front: we can do a one-time onboarding stipend, but I need to confirm the exact format (hosted dollars vs token allocation) and whether the 30% intro discount is something we can standardize or handle as a one-off.

Could you confirm:
- Expected start date for the cohort (you mentioned early Jan — exact week?)
- Estimated total token usage across the 10 teams for the first 30 days (even a ballpark is okay)
- Any data residency / compliance constraints for these teams (e.g., requiring EU region)?

I'll loop in Lauren (lead on promos) to scope the approval path. If you can confirm the numbers, we'll try to get a yes for the stipend + an approved one-month promotional rate.

I'll follow up internally and get you a written confirmation by Friday.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot stipend ask for LaunchForge cohort

Team — forwarding LaunchForge request. Summary: 10-team cohort, asking for a one-time onboarding stipend (~$3k hosted credits) + 30% off month 1 after stipend. Attached SOW.

Why this matters: LaunchForge is a reputable accelerator with good PR and a steady cadence of cohorts; a successful pilot could be a repeatable channel with low CAC. The cohort start is likely week of Jan 4. They estimate ~600k tokens across cohort month 1 (very rough).

Options I'm proposing:
1) Approve $3,000 in hosted credits (applies to the account pool for the cohort) + 30% discount for 30 days after credits expire.
2) Approve $3,000 in token-equivalent credits + standard PLG intro discount (15%) instead of 30%.
3) Decline stipend, offer a usage tier and 15% partner discount for 90 days.

If we approve option 1, we require a short SOW and a simple pilot acceptance email. I think it's low-risk and could be turned into a repeatable partner package.

I've flagged this as time-sensitive — LaunchForge wants a written confirmation this week. Can you advise route and signoff?

Forwarded message included below for context.

--Olga
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot stipend ask for LaunchForge cohort

Thanks for the summary. I like the channel potential here. Approve Option 1 with the following guardrails:
- Cap the promotional stipend at $3,000 hosted credits per cohort (one award per cohort, not per company).
- Require LaunchForge to provide a short acceptance email and list of participating company accounts so we can link credits to the right billing entities.
- Apply a 30% discount for the first 30 days after credits are exhausted, capped at $5k of net discount exposure.
- Pilot must include a post-pilot readout: basic usage metrics and 3 customer quotes (simple template).

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aaron Kim <aaron@launchforge.vc>
Cc: Jenna Ortiz <jenna@launchforge.vc>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2026 17:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot stipend ask for LaunchForge cohort

Aaron — good news: we've approved a pilot stipend for the cohort. Summary of the approved package below (please reply to accept):

Approved pilot package
- One-time onboarding stipend: $3,000 in hosted Redwood credits applied to the LaunchForge cohort pool.
- Introductory pricing: 30% off list rates for 30 days after stipend depletion, with a maximum Redwood exposure of $5,000 for that discount.
- Requirements: LaunchForge to: (1) send a short acceptance email listing participating company accounts; (2) share basic usage metrics at the end of the pilot; (3) allow Redwood to use an anonymized quote from up to 3 founders for joint PR.

Attached: pilot-credit-approval-note.pdf (internal approval note & guardrails).

If that works, we'll prep a short SOW and ask legal for a 1-page amendment for signature.

Thanks — happy to hop on call to finalize.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
